resolved_conflicts.explanation: Ball Butte on firelookout.com and the Idaho lookout list; Bald Butte on Idaho Fire Lookouts. The story uses Ball Butte and notes the variant.

notes_for_editor: Four pages, all giving a 1930s crow's nest that is abandoned. None gives a finer date, a site description or a current status, so the 1930 event year is a placeholder. The record's gone status is corrected to abandoned. A search hit for Beal's Butte near Bovill (a 1905 photo) is probably a different feature and was not used. The 'today' sentence cites the pages read; its quote is the Known Staff heading, the closest support available.
